newsitem.title: FRANCE: HORSE RACING-MOODY MOONAX COSTS DETTORI A TREBLE.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-MOODY MOONAX COSTS DETTORI A TREBLE.

text.p: The Frankie Dettori roadshow moved to Longchamp on Saturday with two more group race winners -- and an astonishing second place on a horse with a distinct attitude problem.
A week ago, Dettori thrilled the racing world with seven winners from seven rides at Ascot.
On Saturday, it was the turn of the Parisian crowd to savour some of the Italian's magic as he won two big races on Annaba and Flemensfirth.
But the real drama was saved for the group one Prix du Cadran, a top test for Europe's spayers, run over four km on yielding ground.

Dettori's partner, a talented but occasionally wayward horse called Moonax, won the the St Leger two years ago but can be a stubborn character and in last year's Cadran he took a bite at one of the opposition.
True to form on Saturday, Moonax behaved mulishly at the start, only consenting to go into the stalls at the last moment.

The duo travelled well enough in mid-division for most of the race but when Dettori asked Moonax to haul in the leader, Nononito, with 300 metres left Moonax swerved violently to the left, throwing away all chance of victory.

To his credit, Dettori managed to steer his horse back on a straight line and ironically Moonax produced such a burst of acceleration that there was only a length in it at the line, with Nononito hanging on grimly.
Typically, Dettori bounced back 35 minutes later to win the Prix Dollar on Flemensfirth.
"I was unlucky in the last race so I'm glad to have won this one," said the British champion.

Like Flemensfirth, both Moonax and Annaba are owned by Sheikh Mohammed, who has bright prospects in Sunday's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe with Swain, ridden by Thierry Jarnet. The Frenchman had three winners on Saturday to warm up for the big test.
Dettori rides Classic Cliche for the Godolphin operation which is closely associated with the Sheikh.

The big disappointment in Saturday's Prix du Cadran was the performance of top British stayer Double Trigger. For the second year running in this race he found the going against him and trailed home a modest fifth.
